title: Aether skill evaluation definitions v2
description: Versioned schema for first-party skill evaluation case files. Supports deterministic structural validation (Layer 1) and routing evaluation (Layer 2). Optional model-assisted evaluation is isolated and must not run on pull requests.

skill.description: Canonical skill name matching the SKILL.md 'name' field and package directory.

version.description: Semantic version of this eval definition file.

cases.description: Ordered list of evaluation cases. Each first-party skill must include at least one case for each required category: positive, negative, insufficient-evidence, and boundary.

id.description: Unique kebab-case identifier for this case within the skill's eval file.

description.description: Human-readable description of the scenario being evaluated.

category.description: Evaluation category. 'positive': canonical use succeeds. 'negative': skill should not trigger. 'insufficient-evidence': required input is missing or contradictory. 'boundary': edge or pressure test. 'failure': known safe-failure behavior.

trigger.description: Expected routing decision. 'should-trigger': skill is the correct tool. 'should-not-trigger': skill must decline. 'not-applicable': trigger is not meaningful for this case.

tags.description: Optional categorization tags for filtering and reporting.

expected.description: Prose statements describing the required behavior or output. Preserved from v1 for human reviewability.

prohibited.description: Behaviors that must NOT appear in the output. Used for safe-failure and negative cases.

assertions.description: Deterministic assertions that can be checked against fixture output without a model.

items.description: A single deterministic assertion checkable without model inference.

value.description: Expected value, pattern, or path depending on assertion type.

fixture.description: Optional relative path (from evals/) to a fixture input file for this case.
